missionPremise: ICC obligation ledger reconciliation and reader, govtech half only (S4-1b, S4-8), per OPS-17 Wave 1 WDLL items 11-12. source_obligation_ledger (hauska-mcp-server) is authoritative; plan_review_activity is a cache per the R-I ruling.
completionPredicate: GET /api/icc/activity (or a named successor surface) reports a reconciliation status between plan_review_activity and source_obligation_ledger that is either a real match/divergence verdict per row, or an honest typed 'cannot compare' state naming why -- never a silent omission and never a fabricated zero-divergence result.
scopeBasis: S4-3 and S4-7 are substrate-owned (hauska-mcp-server); this dispatch was scoped to the plan-review side only, request-not-build for anything in hauska-mcp-server, per the dispatch's own out-of-scope section.
whatHappened: Executed directly per operator instruction (not hand-carried to a lane planner). Partway through implementation, found P:/seat-worktrees/govtech/plan-review actively being written to by a second, already-running process on the exact same branch this session had just created -- files appearing and then disappearing between successive git status checks. Operator confirmed the other process is the legitimate govtech lane planner, already dispatched for this same row, and instructed this session to stand down. This close documents what this session verified and built before stopping; it is not a completion claim for G-109, and the lane planner's own close is authoritative for this row.
verifiedFindingCrossValidatedWithTheOthe: hauska-mcp-server mints request_id server-side via randomUUID() per incoming /mcp POST (src/index.ts:289, read directly, not assumed) and never returns it to the caller in the response body or a header. No plan-review-side reconciliation -- this session's or the lane planner's -- can exactly join plan_review_activity rows to source_obligation_ledger rows until hauska-mcp-server either echoes request_id back or accepts a caller-supplied correlation id. This is a substrate-owned gap, independent of which plan-review implementation ships.
